title: HelperSSHSamplePortsParams
description: One rung of port discovery's ladder, named. The probe is a member of a closed set and not a command: the caller chooses which dialect to run and the helper owns what that dialect is (the text lives in internal/remoteprobe, which both ends link), so a command never crosses this wire. The framing sentinel the caller parses afterwards is printed by the command itself — the answer carries it, so there is nothing to agree on here.
